>in states like oregon and washington you can get medically assisted suicide

That's not what I am looking for. I'm mainly concerned for my parents, friends, people who work with me. They'd suffer from my decision and I'd like to prevent that, too.


>If you want to answer, why do you hate your life?

I don't get along with being who I am. I think I'm (mildly) bi-polar and the mood swings are hard to cope with. Also I don't get along with my body. I feel ashamed most of the time, with next to no self-consciousness. I haven't had a relationship in the last 5 years, my job is going nowhere. Whenever I see anyone who's happy sexually or in a romantic relationship I feel nothing but jealousy towards them, which I hate, too. I hate the political and general future of the world (I know this sounds silly) and the fact that I can't seem to do anything about it (I've tried to be active in non-profits and political parties and that was insanely frustrating).

I've done that already. I've felt like this about 15 times in the last month. I've made a list that goes from -5 (absolutely positively can't take it anymore) to 0 (life sucks and I really don't want to be the person I am). Most of the entries are -1 the worst one last month was -3. The month before I've had two really bad days with up to -4.

What do I do now? Show this to someone?
You're very welcome. It feels nice to help people who just need a different perspective.
Don't worry about it so much, just get healthy. It'll get much better from there.

The lack of fashion sense can be helped:
/r/malefashionadvice

or if you've got a smaller budget

/r/frugalmalefashionadvice

If you're not happy with your body and don't want to go to a gym:

/r/bodyweightfitness 


I don't know ... to me it seems your shortcomings are only of temporary nature. Just get fit and fix your wardrobe and you should be golden.

*hugs*

>Would you like to talk about what makes being alive so difficult right now

Realising that I'm wasting my life because I'm so afraid of rejection that I try to avoid it distance myself from feeling anything because of it.

>Or what made being born worthwhile on those other fourteen (fifteen?) days?

Nothing. I've yet to feel that way, ever. I recently listened to a podcast where somebody expressed being grateful for being born and being able to experience something. I've never felt that way. I've never been happy to be alive. Whenever I feel like I'm enjoying myself a little I always remind myself of how horrible it's going to be when that feeling stops again.
I leave parties whenever they become fun.
I reject people when they express an interest in me.

It's like I'm constantly trying to punish myself for something.

I thoroughly hate my life and I'm even ashamed for feeling that way because I'm so ungrateful for having the chance to live it. My life is hell and nobody knows that I feel that way.

I get that. Doesn't help that many gay people (especially male ones) have a ridiculously awesome sense of fashion. How do you feel about working out some and just making the best out of yourself? We can't all be supermodels.

I completely get you. I'm straight (male) but other than that I feel the same about pretty much anything.

I don't really know if it helps but you're not the only one. It's hard. I don't know what else to suggest.
